prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1273; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left quarter panel shows a crease running toward the wheel well, which lines up well with the reported rear-end impact. The tail lamp assembly is broken and the trunk lid edge is bent. Repair planned: replace the bumper cover and tail lamp, pull and refinish the quarter panel, and realign the trunk lid. The labor hours requested match the scope of this damage. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record, and the parts and labor charges on the invoices show no repeated entries.
